text:
Ravi M: Heads-up — SI partner Meridian says they're seeing marketplace demo leads and want entitlement to own follow-up. What's our policy today?

Dana P: Current default: marketplace demo requests -> Redwood SDRs own initial outreach. Partners can only claim leads if they submitted a partner_referral_upload with timestamped proof. Meridian claims they were selected on the demo form, which is a gray area.

Lena S: Proposal: introduce partner tiers to the intake flow. Premier partners get a 24h soft-claim window, Verified partners get 48h. Also add an ARR override: estimated ARR >= 300k routes to Redwood SDRs regardless.

Jordan (SI Ops): Operationally we need a Confluence mapping: partner | tier | claim_window_hours | arr_override | proof_required | contract_entitlement_flag. Add risk flags: on_prem_hw, nda_required, data_residency. If risk_flags present, escalate to #partnerships-claims immediately.

Jordan (SI Ops): Suggested lightweight claims API webhook schema partners can call when claiming:
{"lead_id":"<id>", "claimed_by":"meridian", "timestamp":"2026-03-21T14:22:00Z", "proof_url":"https://s3.redwood/proofs/..png", "signature":"<HMAC>"}
We validate HMAC against partner key. Manual claims must include screenshot + time-of-click.

Maya Legal: We must retain claim artifacts for 12 months. If any partner has exclusive intro rights per MSA, mark contract_entitlement_flag=true in the mapping and follow contract terms. I'll review Meridian's MSA for carveouts.

Dana P: For the pilot: set Meridian as Premier (24h), require signed webhook or screenshot proof. Marketplace will show a small lead badge: partner_claim_status: pending/accepted/contested so SDR/CS see it.

Lena S: Also add a "border case" rule: if estimated ARR within 20% of threshold route to #partnerships-triage for quick human review.

Ravi M: Action items: Dana — create Confluence schema + sample webhook by Thursday; Jordan — update SI ops playbook with routing pseudo-code; Maya — confirm any MSA entitlements for Meridian; Lena — add risk-flag presets for Meridian. I'll create #partnerships-claims and run this as a 30-day pilot.

ops-bot: Reminder — Partnerships weekly sync Friday 9:00am PT -> https://cal.redwood/partnerships

Ravi M: Thanks everyone. Let's keep the schema machine-readable so Marketplace/CRM can enforce windows automatically.
